Riley (AE): passing SummitHealth to CS — contract signed today. Dedicated (4xGPU) + hosted fallback. They require Okta SCIM, two custom SAML attrs, 24mo audit retention, and may request VPC peering. Goal: PROD in ~6 weeks.
Priya (CSM): thanks Riley. please paste contract link and any pilot notes. i'll own kickoff and acceptance criteria.
Riley (AE): contract: https://redwood.example/contract/SUMM-2026. Pilot: ~115 rps, p95 ~210ms, streaming + rerank used, cost in line.
Priya (CSM): Kai can you validate SAML claim mapping + SCIM provisioning on Dedicated? also confirm export-to-S3 + KMS for 24mo retention.
Kai (SRE): can do a staging pass. need Okta metadata or a test tenant invite. export to S3 supported; will check KMS handshake and lifecycle. ETA 48h. if custom claim transforms needed, may be a small config change (~3 business days).
Jordan (Support): i'll open tickets: SSO/SCIM validation and audit-export options. will tag eng-platform if infra work needed.
Priya (CSM): owners: Priya - kickoff & acceptance criteria; Kai - SCIM/SAML report + retention options (48-72h); Jordan - tickets + triage; Riley - share customer eng contacts. setting Renewal_Risk=medium until retention confirmed.
Riley (AE): i'll send contacts by EOD and note their request for clearer per-routing cost breakdown (adding to product feedback).
reminder-bot: calendar invite "SummitHealth onboarding kickoff" scheduled Thu 09:00 PT (Priya, Kai, Jordan, Riley).
Priya (CSM): quick recap: Kai post findings here, Jordan update tickets, i'll draft acceptance criteria once we have SSO/retention status. thanks team.
